text: dsh-beauty-persist（DSH 插件，桌面 Web 客户端）：让 dream-skin 与 liquid-glass 的壁纸和外观状态在 DSH Desktop 重启、更换端口后继续保留。它在 DSH 主机注册状态、壁纸及素材库接口，并在页面启动时注入已保存状态，客户端同步相关 localStorage 变化。主要功能包括恢复主题设置、上传 GIF 动态壁纸、使用 MP4 视频壁纸，以及在皮肤中心预览、应用和删除素材。适合希望保存桌面视觉设置并管理壁纸素材的 DSH 用户。使用前需要 DSH webServer 服务；状态与素材写入主机的 .dsh 目录。

dsh-beauty-persist keeps DSH desktop wallpaper and theme settings after restarts. It saves and restores visual settings on the host, supports animated GIF and MP4 wallpapers, and offers a skin center to preview, apply, and delete media. It requires DSH webServer.
DSH 桌面换端口或重启后，怎么保留原来的壁纸？
想让主题外观设置在每次启动后自动恢复。
有没有办法把动态 GIF 直接设成 DSH 壁纸？
我想用 MP4 视频做桌面背景并让它循环播放。
能不能在一个页面浏览和管理我的壁纸素材？
想上传图片或动图，以后还能一键切换成壁纸。
How can I keep my DSH desktop wallpaper after a restart?
I want animated GIFs to work as desktop wallpapers.
dsh-beauty-persist 的功能「GIF 动态壁纸」：在外观设置中选择本地 GIF 后，插件将文件保存到主机并切换 dream-skin 到 URL 模式，让浏览器原生播放动图并在重启后继续使用。
dsh-beauty-persist 的功能「MP4 视频壁纸」：可从设置选择或移除 MP4 壁纸。插件上传视频并在页面添加静音全屏视频层，通过交叉淡入淡出衔接循环播放。
dsh-beauty-persist 的功能「皮肤中心素材库」：打开皮肤中心可上传图片、GIF 或视频，浏览缩略图并放大预览；选择素材可立即应用为壁纸，也可从库中删除。
dsh-beauty-persist 的功能「持久保存外观状态」：插件同步相关 localStorage 设置到主机文件，并在页面启动时恢复，保留壁纸与主题选择。
dsh-beauty-persist 使用 DSH 主机的 .dsh 目录保存状态文件、壁纸和素材；可用 DSH_BEAUTY_PERSIST_DIR 指定另一基目录。

dsh-beauty-persist README · dsh-beauty-persist：> Persist [dsh-dream-skin](https://github.com/RevolutionLA/dsh-dream-skin) / [dsh-liquid-glass](https://github.com/Ultronen/dsh-liquid-glass) wallpaper & theme across **DSH Desktop restarts**.

dsh-beauty-persist README · Why：The DSH Desktop shell launches its web carrier with an OS-assigned **random port**
(`--port 0`), so the browser origin changes on every restart. Browser
`localStorage` is partitioned per origin — visual state like a wallpaper image
(stored by dream-skin / liquid-glass in `localStorage`) **disappears after each
restart**, even though it was never deleted.

dsh-beauty-persist README · Why：`dsh-beauty-persist` moves that visual state into a **server-side JSON file** that
is independent of the port. It restores the state on every page load and pushes
changes back to the server when you tweak the settings in the UI.

dsh-beauty-persist README · What it does：- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`)
  - Serves `GET /beauty-persist/state` (current persisted state) and
    `POST /beauty-persist/state` (replace persisted state).
  - Serves `GET /beauty-persist/wallpaper.gif` (the stored GIF wallpaper) and
    `POST /beauty-persist/wallpaper.gif` (upload a new GIF wallpaper).
  - Injects the persisted state into the `index.html` response as
    `window.__DSH_BEAUTY_PERSIST_STATE__`, **before** the boot manifest, so the
    browser half restores synchronously ahead of dream-skin/liquid-glass
    initialization.
- **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`)
  - Restores every `dsh-dream-skin:*` / `dsh-liquid-glass:*` `localStorage` key
    from the server-injected state on page load.
  - Hooks `Storage.prototype.setItem` / `removeItem` and mirrors any later
    changes back to the server (debounced), so your wallpaper/skin choices keep
    persisting without you doing anything extra.
  - Exposes `uploadGifWallpaper(gif)` to set an animated GIF wallpaper.

dsh-beauty-persist README · What it does：State is stored at `~/.dsh/beauty-persist-state.json`; the GIF wallpaper file
lives at `~/.dsh/beauty-persist-wallpaper.gif`.

dsh-beauty-persist README · Install：Works with any profile that already runs `dsh-dream-skin` and/or
`dsh-liquid-glass` (typically the `desktop` profile used by DSH Desktop).

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
dsh-beauty-persist README · add the dependency (adjust the repo URL / tag to what you installed)：pnpm add dsh-beauty-persist@github:<owner>/<repo>

dsh-beauty-persist README · Usage：Nothing to configure. Once installed:

1. Restart DSH Desktop (required for the bundle to load).
2. In the GUI open **Settings → Theme / 外观** and pick your wallpaper / skin as usual.
3. The choice is now persisted server-side — it survives restarts, port changes,
   browser cache clears, and even switching browsers.

dsh-beauty-persist README · Usage：If you already have a wallpaper set in a previous session's `localStorage`
(now orphaned under an old port), either re-pick it once after installing, or
seed the server state manually:

```sh

dsh-beauty-persist README · Animated GIF wallpaper：dream-skin's "pick image" flow re-encodes through a canvas and flattens
animated GIFs into a static JPEG. To use an **animated GIF** instead, upload
it to this plugin — the browser renders the GIF natively (it plays), and the
file is stored server-side so it survives restarts.

dsh-beauty-persist README · Animated GIF wallpaper：**In the GUI (no command line):** after installing, open
**Settings → Theme / 外观** — a **"GIF 壁纸上传（动图）"** row appears in the
appearance section. Click **选择 GIF…**, pick a local `.gif`, and it is
uploaded, activated and persisted. Refresh the GUI to see the animation.

**From the command line:**

```sh
dsh-beauty-persist README · from this repo — the script auto-discovers the DSH Desktop GUI port：node scripts/set-gif-wallpaper.mjs "C:\path\to\my-wallpaper.gif"
section: from this repo — the script auto-discovers the DSH Desktop GUI port

text:
dsh-beauty-persist README · or pass the base URL explicitly if your GUI is served elsewhere：node scripts/set-gif-wallpaper.mjs "C:\path\to\my-wallpaper.gif" http://127.0.0.1:8080
```

After upload, refresh the GUI (or restart DSH Desktop): the GIF plays as the
wallpaper and persists across restarts. Swap it any time by re-running the
script with a different GIF.

text:
dsh-beauty-persist README · MP4 video wallpaper：CSS background-image cannot play video, so MP4 wallpapers are rendered by this
plugin as a full-viewport `<video>` layer (muted, looping, object-fit cover).

**In the GUI:** the **"MP4 视频壁纸（动效）"** row (also under
Settings → Theme / 外观) lets you pick a local `.mp4` and activate it, or
remove the video wallpaper.

**From the command line:**

```sh
node scripts/set-mp4-wallpaper.mjs "C:\path\to\my-wallpaper.mp4"

dsh-beauty-persist README · optional explicit base URL:：node scripts/set-mp4-wallpaper.mjs "C:\path\to\my-wallpaper.mp4" http://127.0.0.1:8080
```

The MP4 is stored at `~/.dsh/beauty-persist-wallpaper.mp4` (up to 50 MB) and
persists across restarts.

dsh-beauty-persist README · 🎨 Skin center (asset library)：Build your own wallpaper library: upload images / GIFs / MP4s once, then
switch between them anytime with one click — everything is stored server-side
and survives restarts.

**In the GUI:** the **"🎨 皮肤中心"** row (under Settings → Theme / 外观)
gives you:

dsh-beauty-persist README · 🎨 Skin center (asset library)：- **上传素材…** — pick a local image / GIF / MP4 to add it to the library
  (stored at `~/.dsh/beauty-persist-assets/`, up to 50 MB each).
- A **thumbnail grid** of your assets — click any thumbnail to apply it as the
  wallpaper right away (images/GIFs render as a background layer, GIFs animate
  natively; MP4s render as a looping video layer).
- **✕** on a thumbnail deletes the asset from the library.

dsh-beauty-persist README · 🎨 Skin center (asset library)：The currently applied asset is remembered in the server-side state, so after a
restart the same wallpaper comes back automatically.

dsh-beauty-persist README · Requirements：- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme` (the standard web client stack; present in
  every shipped Web composition).
- Node `>= 18` for the host half.
